title: Tune and Optimize AI Tool Configuration (August 2026 Best Practices)
body:
# Tune and Optimize AI Tool Configuration (August 2026 Best Practices)

## Overview

Audit, update, and configure the repository's AI instruction files to maximize efficiency of both Anthropic Claude Code and GitHub Copilot Agent modes. This task aligns with August 2026 best practices for context window optimization, multi-agent configuration, and LLM behavior tuning.

## Current Architecture

```
(project root)
├── AGENTS.md                   # Codex/Copilot Custom Multi-Agent routing
├── CLAUDE.md                   # Claude Code core prompt (strictly <300 lines)
├── DESIGN.md                   # System design & architecture principles 
├── SKILLS.md                   # High-level developer competencies definition
├── .claude
│   ├── settings.json           # Checked-in project-wide CLI defaults
│   ├── settings.local.json     # Untracked personal exception configurations
│   └── skills/                 # Custom sub-agent slash commands & logic
└── .github
    ├── copilot
    │   ├── README.md           # Instructions index for team onboarding
    │   ├── rules/              # Scoped language & framework compliance rules
    │   └── templates/          # Code scaffolding & testing templates
    ├── copilot-instructions.md # Repository-level cascading system prompt
    ├── dependabot.yml
    ├── lsp.json                # Project workspace symbols mapping
    └── workflows/              # GitHub Actions configurations
```

## Acceptance Criteria

### 1. CLAUDE.md Structure (Claude Code Native)
- [ ] Keep strictly under 300 lines to avoid token fatigue and rule degradation
- [ ] Define exact Tech Stack & Build/Test/Lint scripts
- [ ] Establish explicit instructions on state preservation (session insights append via "stop hook" pattern)
- [ ] Outline clear boundaries for auto-mode execution (which commands require prompts vs. safe auto-allow)

### 2. .claude/settings.json
- [ ] Configure `effortLevel` (e.g., dynamic extended thinking)
- [ ] Define fallback model overrides
- [ ] Implement local auto-accept parameters
- [ ] Provide JSON schema validation

### 3. .github/copilot-instructions.md (GitHub Copilot Core)
- [ ] Define repository-level coding conventions
- [ ] Specify preferred DTO patterns and error-handling schemas
- [ ] Use clean YAML frontmatter and strict markdown tables for behavioral validation
- [ ] Include "Do / Do Not" rules

### 4. AGENTS.md & Scoped Routing
- [ ] Design explicit directory map coordinating AGENTS.md with `.github/copilot/rules/` and `.claude/skills/`
- [ ] Prevent rule collision and precedence conflicts
- [ ] Define clear handoff criteria: when Copilot steps down for Claude Code deep agentic work
- [ ] Document when Claude Code escalates to Copilot for specific domains

## Deliverables

Generate production-ready configurations:
- ✅ `CLAUDE.md` (revised)
- ✅ `.claude/settings.json` (created/updated)
- ✅ `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (created/updated)
- ✅ `AGENTS.md` (revised to coordinate multi-agent routing)

All configurations must:
- Optimize token consumption and context caching
- Follow Anthropic and GitHub official August 2026 best practices
- Maintain backward compatibility with existing `.claude/rules/` and `.github/instructions/`
- Include clear escalation paths and tool selection matrices

## References

- **Anthropic Claude Documentation:** Context window optimization, extended thinking, model selection
- **GitHub Copilot Agent Mode Docs:** Multi-agent routing, instruction inheritance, skill discovery
- **Project Documentation:** AGENTS.md (current multi-agent workflow), DESIGN.md (architecture)

## Technical Notes

- **Token Budget:** Optimize for efficient context reuse across concurrent agents
- **Fallback Strategy:** Define clear model downgrade paths for lower-tier devices/contexts
- **Skill Discovery:** Leverage `.claude/skills/` and `.github/copilot/rules/` auto-discovery mechanisms
- **State Persistence:** Implement session logging and checkpoint-based state recovery

## Implementation Path

1. Review current AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and `.claude/settings.json` for baseline
2. Audit existing `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and create if missing
3. Harmonize routing rules and prevent precedence conflicts
4. Generate production-ready versions with inline documentation
5. Validate configuration syntax and test agent routing
6. Update `.github/copilot/README.md` with new instruction index
